description.en: Fades the screen's out-of-focus blur ("boke") effect to the given intensity (typically 0.0) over a number of frames and removes it, the counterpart to CMND_BOKE_CREATE.
Target blur intensity to fade to before removing the effect (typically 0.0).
True once the call has taken effect; null if the call was invalid (e.g. too few arguments, or required engine/script state not ready).

example.code:
// Fade out and remove the screen blur effect
CMND_BOKE_DELETE(0.0, 7.0);
